evidence_quotes: onder oplegging van een dwangsom gelast om zich te onthouden van overtreding van de artikelen 6.2, eerste lid, 6.8 en 6.9, eerste lid, van de Waterwet.
rationale: Dutch Council of State (RvS) decision concerning an administrative enforcement order (last onder dwangsom) requiring the appellant to refrain from violating articles 6.2(1), 6.8 and 6.9(1) of the Waterwet (governing direct surface-water discharge permitting, water-system pollution duty of care and incident obligations). This is substantively a Waterwet regulatory/discharge-compliance dispute and does not involve household service connection or informal settlements.
